findings.title: Dine-in Channel Revenue Decline Week-over-Week
findings.claim: The dine_in channel, which showed the largest absolute revenue change, generated SAR 19566.20 (net of refunds) in the analysis week (2026-06-08 to 2026-06-15) across 574 transactions, compared to SAR 22007.10 (net of refunds) across 636 transactions in the previous week (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-08), representing a decline of SAR 2440.90 or 11.09%.
coverage_notes: Revenue figures are net of refunds (refunds included as negative values in line_total_sar)
Dine_in channel selected as the channel with largest absolute revenue change
Transaction counts derived from unique transaction_id values
All line_total_sar values included in revenue calculations
assumptions: Timestamp field accurately represents transaction time
Channel field correctly identifies transaction channel
line_total_sar represents net revenue after discounts and refunds
Refunds are included in line_total_sar as negative values
Selection of dine_in channel based on largest absolute change may introduce selection bias

findings.title: Average Order Value Decline Week-over-Week
findings.claim: Average order value declined from SAR 34.35 in the previous week (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-08) to SAR 34.79 in the analysis week (2026-06-08 to 2026-06-15), representing a decline of SAR 0.44 or 1.28%. This decline occurred across 1268 transactions in the analysis week compared to 1425 transactions in the previous week.
coverage_notes: AOV calculated as total revenue divided by unique transaction count
Revenue includes refunds in net calculation (refunds as negative values)
All transactions with valid transaction_id included
assumptions: Timestamp field accurately represents transaction time
line_total_sar represents net revenue after discounts and refunds
Each transaction_id represents a unique basket
No data quality issues affecting revenue or transaction counts

findings.title: Category Revenue Change: bakery
findings.claim: The bakery category showed the largest absolute revenue change, generating SAR 5008.10 (net of refunds) in the analysis week (2026-06-08 to 2026-06-15) compared to SAR 6597.60 in the previous week (2026-06-01 to 2026-06-08), representing a change of SAR -1589.50 or -24.09%.
coverage_notes: Category selected as the category with largest absolute revenue change
Revenue includes refunds in net calculation (refunds as negative values)
Transaction counts derived from unique transaction_id values
All line_total_sar values included in revenue calculations
assumptions: Category field correctly identifies product category
line_total_sar represents net revenue after discounts and refunds
Refunds are included in line_total_sar as negative values
Each transaction_id represents a unique basket
Selection of category based on largest absolute change may introduce selection bias
